title: Body data beside your shoulder
description: Film-style corner brackets and hairlines ride beside your shoulder and read your body live: shoulder tilt, head turn, hand height, with a trace of the shoulder line. Your title on top.

props.hand: left | right: which shoulder (default: the side with more room)

source.note: uses the body detector (work/body.json: hands, joints, face) read every frame through meta "rig"
